Copy the platform profile, kernel subsystem models, and .th sources out of the pinned upstream into this repository, preserving attribution. Produces a tree this repository owns and can diverge from.

```day-atom
{"in":["pinned-dependency"],"out":["forked-platform"],"next":["baseline-build"]}
```
